messages:
sara_sales: Heads-up — Hyperion wants a concise POC runbook + cost estimate. Baseline load = 180 rps, short bursts to 1200 rps for 90s every 25m. They need SAML + private endpoint for the trial. Can we lock plan + quick token cost and minimal security checklist?
dev_perf: Proposed phases: warmup (15m @ 40%), steady (1.5h @ 180rps), burst cycles (90s @1200rps every 25m for 6h), soak (6h @100rps). Capture p50/p95/p99, batch hist, queue depth, gpu util, kv cache hit.
noah_infra: Runner snippet: ```rbench --model redwood-13b-q4 --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --qps 180 --concurrency 72 --duration 5400 --burst-pattern "1200@90s:every25m" --warmup 900``` I'll provision 5 x a100-like nodes and a burst autoscaler. Canary route to 13b-quant ready as fallback.
dev_perf: Tuning recs: batching.max_tokens=80, batching.max_wait_ms=10 steady; bump max_wait to 25ms in bursts. Warmup should repeat prefixes to populate KV cache — that reduces p99 notably.
tess_sec: Minimal shareable checklist: IdP metadata XML, test admin accounts, corporate IPs for allowlist, desired region, HSM required? We can provide privatelink or VPC peering for the two-week trial. SOC2/ISO docs available on request.
leo_ae: Cost ask: quick token estimate for the full 24h run and monthly delta if they commit to reserved baseline for 180rps vs on-demand. Need one-slide numbers for procurement.
dev_perf: Token math (est): assume 38 tokens/req. Tokens/hr = 180 * 38 * 3600 = 24,696,000. For 24h ~592.7M tokens. At $0.00075/1k tokens => ~ $444 run cost. Add ~12% for burst infra => ~$498. Reserved baseline pricing would reduce unit cost ~20-30% depending on term.
noah_infra: ops-bot: provisioning scheduled: 5 x a100_sim nodes allocated to sales-sandbox 2027-09-10 08:00 PT -> 2027-09-11 08:00 PT. Artifacts path: /shared/sales/hyperion/2134567890/
ci-bot: [system] Quick smoke started: 15m @ 180rps warmup -> will report.
dev_perf: Metrics to log: p50/p90/p95/p99, tokens_per_request, batch_size_hist, queue_time_ms, gpu_util_pct, kv_cache_hit_pct, and per-route errors.
ci-bot: [system] Smoke result: 15m warmup + 10m steady 180rps -> p95=185ms, p99=420ms, kv_cache_hit=79%. Artifacts: /shared/sales/hyperion/2134567890/smoke.csv
dev_perf: Reaction: p99 ok for steady. For bursts we may hit p99 ~700-900ms; if so increase batching.max_wait_ms and enable soft-priority for latency-sensitive route. Noah — please schedule burst soak after lunch and upload results.
leo_ae: Great — I'll prepare a short slide: 1) run plan 2) cost estimate ~$500 incl bursts 3) 99% POC uptime SLA and rollback to smaller model within 5m if p95 breach persists. Tess — paste the checklist snippet I can send to procurement.
tess_sec: Paste: "We support SAML 2.0 (provide IdP metadata XML), temporary VPC peering or privatelink, KMS-managed keys for tenant data. SOC2 & ISO27001 reports available. HSM: additional onboarding required"
sara_sales: Thanks everyone — once the burst soak artifacts are uploaded I'll finalize the email to Hyperion.
